changes: Added authority readiness status fields and JSON output for off, shadow, and enforce modes; added conduit status/explain parity, CLI schema support for json flags, authority-status smoke coverage, README/guide/authority-client-role docs, and fixed the guide authority-client-role link display text.
usage: Run lattice authority_status --json for local/off readiness, run KOALA_AUTHORITY_MODE=enforce lattice authority_status --json to inspect missing enforce prerequisites, and run npm run test:authority-status-smoke for mechanical regression coverage.
expectedOutcome: Default off mode remains locally usable and never claims production authority. Enforce mode without server, actor key, or runner ID reports actionable warnings while receiptVerified, productionDone, and canClaimProductionDone remain false.
actualTranscript: Off mode authority_status JSON showed mode off, localWorkflowUsable true, productionDone false, receiptVerified false, canClaimProductionDone false, and no readinessWarnings. Enforce mode authority_status JSON showed three readinessWarnings for missing URL, actor key, and runner ID while keeping localWorkflowUsable true and all production authority claims false. npm run test:authority-status-smoke printed: authority status readiness smoke passed.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch: status output and smoke results match the expected local/off compatibility and enforce readiness semantics.
limitations: Diagnostics only: this story does not sign envelopes, submit evidence, verify AuthorityReceipt, or make local JSON/status output authoritative for production DONE gates.
pitfalls: Claude Code CLI edit permission prompts required bypassPermissions for implementation. Docs reviewer caught a misleading link display text even though the href resolved; the fix keeps docs/guide.md relative link text consistent. Koala validate updates tracked test-evidence.json, so validation evidence must be committed.
